decision: Operator decision 2026-11-26 (coordinator session 70b5f70f): Agora is for human traders; the Agora committee lists only meetings the trader convened plus MT-4 reviews whose subject is the trader; persona gate panels and institutional persona meetings are viewed in the Management meetings center. Supersedes M10 of docs/04/pantheon_persona_meetings_2026-11-15/SD_PERSONA_MEETINGS_2026-11-15.md; amendment A2 stays.
cause: Hosted 2026-11-26 15:06Z (BFF b0eb2c259): GET /bff/agora/committee/sessions returned 28 tenant-wide items (7 consult-envelope-publication gate panels first, then 21 deliberative meetings oldest first), none convened by an agora_user. CommitteeOwnerClient.sessions merged every persona_panel request with every owner meeting; only project_meeting hid other users' agora_user meetings. GET /bff/management/meetings listed deliberative meetings only.

agora_committee.scope: trader_owns_meeting(): convened_by kind agora_user with id == caller, or MT-4 (meeting_code/meeting_type/meeting_slug in MT-4, performance_attribution_review) whose subject (subject_ref trader:/agora_user:/user:<id>, or attribution_record agora_user_id/trader_id/user_id/subject) is the caller; gate panels never qualify
agora_committee.routes: sessions, meetings (include_panels accepted, ignored), proposals and meetings/proposals use CommitteeOwnerClient.trader_meetings/trader_proposals; sessions/{id}, meetings/{id}, memos, meetings/{id}/proposals and publish use trader_meeting(), which answers unavailable(consultation, meeting_not_found, 404) for a missing, foreign-tenant, other-owner, institutional or gate-panel id alike
agora_committee.list_shape: newest first by created_at; created_at and closed_at; chair_display_name, participants[].display_name, rounds[].positions[].display_name from the persona directory resolver (falls back to id with *_name_missing); caller's private servant labelled 'Your servant' with is_caller_servant=true; empty list reason no_trader_meetings
agora_committee.owner_reads: owner meeting list paged in full (limit 500, max 20 pages); ownership decided on list rows before any detail read; MT-4 rows without a trader subject in the list read one detail to check the attribution record; memos reuse the scoped meeting detail (1 meeting read + 1 memo read)
agora_committee.unchanged: CommitteeOwnerClient.meeting/proposals/sessions/memos keep their behaviour for candidate-decision and persona-cycle callers

management_meetings.list: GET /bff/management/meetings (and /bff/meetings) adds persona_panel requests on the first page as session_class gate_panel with created_at, completed_at, closed_at, conclusion {gate_decision, operator_decision_required, vetoed_by, reasons, reviewers[{persona_id, persona_display_name, role, recommendation}]}, title '<persona display name> pool v<N> envelope publication: <reviewer> <recommendation>, ... -> <gate decision>'; all rows newest first; status/type/persona filters apply; a non-panel type skips panel reads; panel read failure keeps deliberative rows and sets meta.surfaces.gate_panels unavailable
management_meetings.detail: GET /bff/management/meetings/{id} falls back to the gate panel when the owner has no such meeting: positions (round 1), memo (committee_summary) and memos, case_file_view via the existing project_panel projection, conclusion and title
